operating_risks.closure: Qualify brake-open, supply-loss and worst-stop energy/transients; driver inhibit is not an energy sink.
TPS26630 removes the deliberate 2x pulse allowance. Qualify its finite limiting/fast-trip response with the exact EPR source/cable and measure all upstream loads against the allocation.
Agree the motor current waveform and qualify winding, MOSFET, shunt, capacitor and connector temperatures; the local TMP102 is insufficient evidence.
Specify load energy, duty, resistor pulse limits, thermal interface, heatsink and mechanical installation.
Measure each bulk-capacitor ripple/heating and Q16 VDS turn-off overshoot with the intended brake harness; qualify any required clamp/snubber.

commissioning_profile.scope: Unloaded rotor only; no coupling, driven load, gravity load or external back-drive
commissioning_profile.selection_basis: Retained low-energy commissioning choice; not copied from PD-1180 ratings

brake_open_sensitivity.note: Lossless energy screen only. The 1.5 A/phase and 15 rpm sensitivity is an engineering allocation requiring measurement; it does not close startup continuity, running brake failure or transient margin.

commissioning_profile.note: Clock, current regulation, winding nonlinearity and speed are uncalibrated. No attached load is allowed in this prototype scope; unknown application inertia remains unknown in motor-data.json.

brake_gate_supply.note: PFM regulation and resistor temperature allowances included. Saturation rating is specified at 25 C; hot current, capacitor bias, load steps and startup remain measured qualification items.

overload_after_pgood.note: TPS26630 1x active limiting, TI 8.3.7.1.1. Finite loop response and a separate 2x fast-trip threshold can still permit brief overshoot; this is not an ideal instantaneous 5 A clamp.

efuse_thermal_screen.note: I²R applies while fully enhanced. Active limiting dissipates (VIN-VOUT)*I and invokes thermal regulation/shutdown; MODE remains open for latch-off. No PCB thermal impedance, SOA or restart qualification is inferred.

supply.note: Input limit is not a phase-current limit. The 250 mA upstream allocation must be verified on hardware; the 4.99k interpolation and device-error allowance are screening assumptions.

thresholds_v.coordination_note: U13 and U14 share the same U12 output, verified in compiled connectivity. U12 error is common; comparator offset/CMRR/PSRR and resistor errors are independent. Independent absolute envelopes may overlap across different boards. Dynamic separation still requires measurement.
thresholds_v.note: Screening corners, not a qualified min/max specification. Shared reference prevents treating the two trips as independent distributions.

current.motor_rating_note: Manufacturer states AMPS/PHASE, not an approved driver RMS setpoint. Resolve waveform, peak/hold current and thermal limits before motor-enabled firmware.
current.note: DRV8262DDV nominal current uses MCP4822 gain=2 (1 mV/code), 212 uA/A current mirrors and 1.5k resistors. Below 50 mV that winding is braked. Low-current mirror error is not specified across the entire waveform. No measured or guaranteed tolerance interval is asserted. The 6 A RMS analysis case is not motor authorization.

dissipation_w.note: Loss estimates exclude switching losses and do not determine junction temperature. DDV conduction cases require a top heatsink/TIM model; these are not junction-temperature predictions.

inrush.note: No-load linear ramp model; thermally regulated startup, MLCC bias and additional loads alter the ramp. Verify eFuse SOA and PGOOD timing.

brake_unavailable_return_screen.note: All remaining winding energy returned to the bus after inhibit; lossless screening cases, not measured or predicted waveforms. Inductance under operating current, current tolerance, ESR/ESL, source response and mechanical energy are not bounded by this model. Exceeding 55 V requires closure even when static threshold checks pass.

regeneration.note: Brake sizing requires load inertia, stop time, duty and gravity. 300 W LPS300 rating requires 85 C maximum case temperature; pulse energy and repetition must be checked separately.

ripple_and_brake_switch.note: A rating at 100 kHz is not a validated chopping/braking waveform rating. D20 provides a local cable-inductance recirculation path and R134 feeds startup continuity sensing. Their presence does not qualify switching overshoot or runtime brake integrity.

brake_feedback.note: D20 2 mA at 125 C rated reverse voltage is the leakage screen; higher junction temperatures and actual ADC errors need qualification. Divider is 1%, 100 ppm/C, two 250 mW 1206 top resistors; board ambient design limit 50 C, local temperature must stay within derated ratings.

telemetry.note: Nominal transfer only; ADC/reference/gain errors, offset, common-mode switching and sampling require calibration.

outstanding: Measured DRV8262 VM transient margin and DDV top-heatsink/TIM performance
PD source/cable finite current-limit and fast-trip coordination; upstream current measurement
Ordered motor current convention, external load inertia, speed, ambient and mechanics qualification
TI-generated EEPROM image and approved configuration identity
Assembled-board current, thermal, USB, brake and fault measurements
